convert_keypoint_definition: convert 2D keypoints from COCO or AIC dataset format to Human36M format for 3D pose lifting
extract_pose_sequence: extract a fixed-length pose sequence centered on a target frame with padding for video frames
collate_pose_sequence: reorganize multi-frame 2D pose results into individual person pose sequences using track IDs
inference_pose_lifter_model: infer 3D poses from 2D pose sequences using a trained pose lifter model
review_inference_3d_module: review the inference_3d module functions for 3D pose lifting from 2D keypoints
